name: No Love No Money
source:
Nikakun is an ordinary student at an ordinary school for future game developers.
When terrorist attacks begin to occur in the city, Nikakun finds himself at the very center of events.
He must choose not only between girls, but also between the socio-political positions they represent.

What will our hero choose?
Love or Money?
Or maybe destroy both?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793540/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Nikakun是一所普通未来游戏开发学校的普通学生。
当恐怖袭击开始在这座城市发生时，尼昆发现自己处于事件的中心。
他不仅必须在女孩之间做出选择，还必须在她们所代表的社会政治立场之间做出选择。

我们的英雄会选择什么？
爱情还是金钱？
或者也许摧毁两者？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793540/]Steam[/url]]
